text:
lina_cs: Morning team — quick capture from Seaborne preflight: customer-managed CMK, 7-year immutable audit retention, cross-account delivery to analytics account, and three static IPs for SIEM. List day0 gates?
devon_net: Network questions: public egress via NAT GW + EIPs or private Direct Connect? Need Splunk IPs and AZ redundancy requirements. Also confirm VPC CIDR and whether we must avoid overlap with analytics account.
nate_sec: Compliance asks: WORM enforcement, retention proof, and FIPS requirements for KMS. Do they need Object Lock governance mode and legal holds?
anya_kms: KMS options: symmetric CMK in customer's account (recommended) or CloudHSM-backed custom key store. We can add a cross-account IAM role for analytics decrypt. Need their role ARN.
anya_kms: Draft policy snippet: {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowAnalytics","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987650000000:role/SeaborneIngestRole"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}]}
mike_infra: Logs plan: agent in private subnets -> Kinesis -> Firehose -> S3 in analytics acct. Use envelope encryption with their CMK and include daily signed manifest (SHA256). Will need S3 PutObject permission for Firehose role cross-account.
devon_net: Egress plan: propose NAT GW per AZ with EIPs assigned; route tables point to local AZ NAT for low cross-AZ latency. If they want single static set, consider Global Accelerator.
tim_seaborne: Seaborne confirms analytics acct 987650000000, cannot stand up CloudHSM now, symmetric CMK is acceptable. Splunk requires 3 static IPs, multi-AZ failover ok.
lina_cs: Actions: (1) request analytics role ARN (Tim) (2) EIP mapping proposal (Devon) (3) S3 bucket policy template for Firehose PutObject (Mike) (4) retention/export runbook for 7y + proof-of-archival (Nate) (5) draft KMS policy and support access plan (Anya). Flagging renewal risk if retention not validated in 30 days.
ops_bot: Ticket CS-8533 created for Seaborne preflight; follow-up scheduled in 48h.
anya_kms: For Redwood support access we suggest a time-limited AssumeRole with mfa condition; will draft trust policy.
mike_infra: Proposed object layout: seaborne/<env>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<instance>-<seq>.json.gz plus daily manifest.json.gz. Include object metadata with SHA256 and upload timestamp.
nate_sec: Recommend S3 Object Lock (Governance), MFA Delete on archival bucket, and lifecycle to Glacier Deep Archive. Document export/playback and POA.
lina_cs: I'll consolidate these notes and send to Seaborne by EOD. If any missing blockers (TLS cert pinning for SIEM, HEC token rotation, or cross-account SCPs) call them out now.
